content: Kɨritsitu kemɨranukuketɨarie 'umierieka
Ne'iwama, nekanixetahekɨatsitɨiyamɨkɨ niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne, kenemɨtixekuxaxatɨwakai. Xekanitanaki'erieni mɨkɨ niuki, hetsiena xetewiyatɨ xekaniuti'uni.
Xɨka kwi xe'eyexeiyani tita nemɨtixekuxaxatɨwakai, mɨkɨ niukikɨ xekanitawikweitsitɨarieximeni, mexɨka yakɨ xeikɨa yuri xete'uta'erieni.
Ne nekanixeyetuirieni tita matsi mɨreuyewetse, kenemɨtiyetuiriyarie neta, kename Kɨritsitu 'umɨ tame 'axatemɨte'uyurikɨ, 'utɨarikate maine hepaɨ,
kename 'ukateukie, kename 'anukuketɨarie hairieka tukari 'aye'aku, 'utɨarikate maine hepaɨ,
kename Tsepaxi 'ixei, 'arike tamamata heimana yuhutatɨ me'ixei.
'Arike 'auxɨwime tsienituyari heimana yameyupaɨmetɨ mekanixeiya 'axeikɨa 'iwamarixi. Yumɨiretɨ mɨkɨ 'amekaniu'uwani hikɨ 'akuxi, hipatɨri mekaneukutsu.
'Arike Kakuwu kanixeiya, 'ariketa nɨ'ariekate yunaitɨ mekanixeiya.
'Imatɨrieka neta nekanixeiya, kemɨ'ane nunutsi yɨritɨ mutinuiwaxɨ hepaɨ ne'anetɨ.
Nɨ'ariekate watsata nekani'imatɨremetɨni, 'aixɨa nepɨkatiuka'iyari nehetsie mɨtinakenikɨ nɨ'ariekame nemɨtaterɨwarienikɨ, nemɨwareutaweiyaxɨakaikɨ mɨkɨ memeyutixexeɨriwa Kakaɨyari hetsɨa miemete.

Peru Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyarikɨ, 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ nekani'aneni kenemɨ'ane. Yakɨ xeikɨa pɨka'uyɨ, 'aixɨa kemɨtiuka'iyarikai nehetsiemieme. Ne matsi kwinimieme nekatini'uximayaka, mɨkɨ yunaitɨ kememɨkate'uximayatawawe. Peru ne nepɨkahɨkɨ kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ mɨtiyuriene. Kakaɨyari pɨta 'aixɨa tiuka'iyaritɨ nehamatɨa yakatini'uximayaka.
Merikɨte, tsepa ne, yatɨni mɨkɨ, mɨpaɨ tekatenihekɨatani, xemeta mɨpaɨ yuri xekateniuta'erieni.
Mɨkite kememɨte'anuku'uni
Kɨritsitu xɨka kuxaxatsiwani mɨkite watsata manukuketɨarie, keme'utiyuane xeme hipatɨ, kename waniu, mɨkite meka'anuku'uni.
Mɨkite xɨka meka'anuku'uni, meta Kɨritsitu pɨka'anukuketɨarienikeyu.
Merikɨte, xɨka Kɨritsitu ka'anukuketɨarieni, yakɨxeikɨa kanayani tita temɨtehekɨata, yakɨxeikɨa yuri xekateniuta'erieni.
Xɨka mɨkite meka'anuku'uni, kanimatsiɨkɨni ketemɨte'itawa tameta, 'axatemɨtehekɨatakɨ Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita, kename henukuketɨa Kɨritsitu te'utiyuatɨ, mɨkɨ kahenukuketɨaku, xɨka mɨpaɨ 'aneni.
Merikɨtsɨ, mɨkite xɨka meka'anuku'uni, Kɨritsitu pɨka'anukuketɨarieweta.
Xɨka Kɨritsitu ka'anukuketɨarieni, yakɨxeikɨa yuri xekateniuta'erieni, tita 'axaxemɨteyuriekaitsie xekateniwiyani 'akuxi.
Mɨkɨ meta, mɨkɨ memeukutsixɨa Kɨritsitutsie metewiyatɨ, mɨkɨ mekaniutatɨmaiyarieniri.
Hikɨ mexi te'ayeneniere, xɨka yuri tete'eriekake Kɨritsitu hetsie teta'ikwewatɨ xeikɨa, yunaime teɨteri watsata tame matsi kaneuyewekakeyu temɨnenimayatsiekakɨ.
Peru mɨpaɨ pɨka'ane. Kɨritsitu kananukuketɨarieniri mɨkite watsata, mɨkɨ memeukutsixɨa wamatɨari hɨkɨtɨtɨ.
Tewi kemɨtiuyuri, tame tekanitakukuweni. Yaxeikɨata xewitɨ tewi kemɨtiuyuri, mekananuku'uikuni mɨkite.
'Arani hetsie metewiyatɨ yunaitɨ kememɨtetakukuwe, mɨpaɨrita Kɨritsitu hetsie metewiyatɨ yunaitɨ mekananutanieritɨariekuni,
yuxexuitɨ wahetsiemieme kemɨreuyewetse. Kɨritsitu wamatɨaritɨtɨ kananukukeniri. 'Ariketa mɨkɨ Kɨritsitu hetsɨa memɨmiemete mekananuku'uikuni kepauka munuani.

'Arike naitɨ katinitaparimɨkɨ, kepauka Kɨritsitu kemɨti'aita mɨyetuanitsie, 'ukiyarieya mɨti'aitanikɨ Kakaɨyaritɨtɨ. Yakatiniyetuiriemɨkɨ waka'uname yunaitɨ memɨte'aita, yunaitɨ heitserie memexeiya tɨrɨkariya memexeiya.
Kaneuyeweka Kɨritsitu mɨti'aitanikɨ mexi wara'iwa yunaime memi'uxie.
'Imatɨrieka kemɨrayu'iwa, katanixɨnamɨkɨ temɨkatakukuwenikɨri.

Kakaɨyari naime katiniyetuirieni mɨti'aitanikɨ, kemaine 'utɨarika. Kepauka mɨpaɨ maine, naime katiniyetuirieni 'utaitɨ, kanihekɨaka Kakaɨyari mɨkaxatakɨ kemɨ'ane naime mɨtiukayatsaxɨ, Kɨritsitu mɨti'aitanikɨ.

Kepauka mɨkɨ naime mɨti'aitani, 'anari mɨkɨta yɨkɨmana kaniyuyetuamɨkɨ, 'ukiyarieya pɨta mɨti'aitɨakakɨ, 'ukiyarieya naime mukayatsaxɨkɨ nu'aya mɨti'aitanikɨ. 'Anari Kakaɨyari naitɨ hetsiena mieme katinayeimɨkɨ.
Xɨka meka'anuku'uitɨariwani, ¿kemeteyurieni mɨkɨ memuka'ɨyarie mɨkite wahetsiemieme? Xɨka yemekɨ mɨkite meka'anuku'uitɨarieni, ¿titayari wahetsiemieme mete'uka'ɨyarie?
Tameta, ¿titayari kweriwa'anekɨa tete'u'uwa tukarikɨ?
Tukarikɨ 'etsiwatɨkaku nekanikɨmɨmɨkɨni tɨma. 'Ipaɨ nepaine 'aixɨa nemutainekɨ xehepaɨtsita ne'iwama, kenemɨtinetemawie nexeha'eriwatɨ Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi mɨtati'aitɨwame hetsie.
¿Teɨteri kememɨteniniuki, 'Epetsutsie xɨka ne yeutari wahamatɨa neyumienenike, ketitatsɨkuta nera'iwakekai? Xɨka mɨkite meka'anuku'uitɨarieni,
Xepɨkate'irɨwiyarieka: «'Axamemɨte'u'iyari wahamatɨa 'uyeikatɨ, huye 'aixɨa mɨ'ane kaneuyehɨamɨkɨ».
Xekeneyuta'eriwani heitseriemekɨ kemɨreuyewetse, 'axaxepɨkateyurieka. Hipatɨ xeme 'atsixepɨkatehetimaiwawe Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita. 'Ipaɨ nepaine nexetewiyatsitɨanike.
Kehepaɨ me'anenetɨ mepanuku'uni
Matsi xewitɨ kanita'iwaumɨkɨ: «¿Kehepaɨ mɨkite mete'anuku'uitɨarieni? ¿Kehepaɨ wawaiyari 'aneneni?»
Kari 'atsipepɨkatimate mɨpaɨ pehaitɨ. Tita pemɨtiuka'e, mɨkɨ xɨka ka'umɨni, pɨka'anutanieritɨarieni.
Mɨkɨ meta, tita pemɨtiuka'e, tita mɨtitineika hepaɨ 'aneme pepɨka'uka'e. 'Imɨari mɨmawe xeikɨa pekaniuka'eni, tɨriku 'imɨariyari yatɨni xeime 'imɨariyari.
Kakaɨyari kanikemaritɨaka kemɨtinake, meta xexuime 'imɨari kemɨ'anene yɨkɨ tikemaritɨatɨ.
Naitɨ waiyari yaxeikɨa pɨka'anene. Teɨteri wawaiyari pɨxewitɨ, meta yeutari wawaiyari yɨkɨ pɨ'anene, ketsɨte wawaiyari yɨkɨ pɨ'anene, meta wikixi wawaiyari yɨkɨ pɨ'anene.
Taheima miemete, kwiepa miemete, yunaitɨ yɨkɨ mekani'aneneni. Taheima mieme witsipɨ'anene, kwiepa mieme witsi'anenetɨ yɨkɨ pɨ'anene.
Tau witsikani'aneni, metsa witsipɨ'ane yɨkɨ 'anetɨ, meta xurawetsixi witsimepɨ'anene yɨkɨ me'anenetɨ. Yuxexuitɨ xurawetsixi yɨkɨ 'aneneme yuxawatɨriya mekanexeiyani.
Mɨpaɨrita katiniyɨmɨkɨ kepauka mɨkite memanuku'uitɨarieni. Tita titipɨnirɨmetɨ mɨtiuka'etsie, mɨkɨ katipɨniwetɨ katinanukuketɨariemɨkɨ,
tita 'axatikɨhɨawarɨwatɨ mɨtiuka'etsie, mɨkɨ witsi'anetɨ kananukuketɨariemɨkɨ, tita katɨrɨkaɨyetɨ mɨtiuka'etsie, mɨkɨ tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kananukuketɨariemɨkɨ.
Waitɨtɨ tita mɨtiuka'etsie, mɨkɨ 'iyaritsie miemetɨtɨ kananukuketɨariemɨkɨ. Xɨka rawaiyari xuaweni wai xeikɨa hɨkɨtɨtɨ, meta rawaiyari kanixuaweni 'iyaritsie miemetɨtɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katine'uka: «Mexɨakame tewi, 'Arani mɨtitewakai, 'ayenieretɨ kanayani». Mɨkɨ 'imatɨreme 'Arani pɨta, 'iyari tukari tiyupitɨwame kanayani.
Peru tewi 'iyaritsie mieme meri pɨkahexeiya. Wai xeikɨa meri kanexeiyani, 'arike 'iyaritsie mieme kanexeiyakamɨkɨ.
Mexɨakame tewi kwiepa kanimiemetɨkaitɨni, kwiekɨ mutawewiyakɨ, hutarieka mieme tewi taheima pɨta kanimiemetɨni.
Kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ kwiekɨ mutawewiya, mɨpaɨta mekani'aneneni kwiepa miemete. Kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ taheima mɨmieme, mɨpaɨta mekani'aneneni taheima miemete.
Ketemɨte'u'uwakai mɨkɨ kwiekɨ mutawewiya hepaɨ tekemaritɨarietɨ, yaxeikɨa 'atekaniu'uwakuni mɨkɨ taheima mɨmieme hepaɨ tekemaritɨarietɨ.
'Ipaɨ nepaine ne'iwama, tita mɨtiwai mɨtixuriya, mɨkɨ pɨkayɨweni heixeiyatɨ mayanikɨ tita Kakaɨyari mɨra'aita. Tita mɨtipɨniwe pɨkayɨwe mɨkatipɨniwe heixeiyatɨ mayanikɨ.
Kamɨtsɨ netinixetahekɨatɨamɨkɨ tita mɨti'awietsiekai. Tanaitɨ tepɨkaheukutsu, peru tanaitɨ tekanipatsiekuni
yapauka, xeikɨpiyarikɨ, 'imatɨrieka kuxineta tahɨtsierieyu. Kanitahɨtsieriemɨkɨ, mɨkite mekananuku'uitɨariekuni mekatipɨniwawetɨ, tameta tekanipatsiekuni.
Kaneuyeweka 'ikɨ mɨtipɨniwe menakatɨni tita mɨkatipɨniwe, 'ikɨ mumɨxime menakatɨni tita mɨkatimɨwe.
'Anari, kepauka 'ikɨ mɨtipɨniwe menakatɨni tita mɨkatipɨniwe, kepauka 'ikɨ mumɨxime menakatɨni tita mɨkatimɨwe, 'ana kanaye'amɨkɨ mɨkɨ niuki mɨpaɨ mɨre'uxa: «Mɨɨya kaniukumaweriyarieni 'a'iwarieka».
'Axatemɨteyuriekɨ tekanikutseiwani tekwi'itɨ. 'Inɨari niukiyari kanitɨrɨkariyani tita 'axatemɨteyurie.
Peru pamɨpariyutsi Kakaɨyari tekanipitɨaka, mɨkɨ mɨtatsipitɨakɨ temɨte'ayu'iwanikɨ, Tati'aitɨwame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu tatsiparewiekaku.

'Ayumieme ne'iwama nemɨxenaki'erie, xetseiriyarietɨ xekenakɨni, xepɨkayuyuitɨarinɨaka. Kwini mieme xeketene'uximayaka Ti'aitame hetsiemieme yuheyemekɨ, mɨpaɨ xetemaitɨ, Ti'aitame hetsie xetewiyatɨ tsepa xemɨteyu'uxitɨa, yakɨ xeikɨa pɨkarayani.
